purpose: verify that the physically grounded service-quality signal supports learnability before another full baseline budget

changes_from_v1_3.persistent_service_quality: active physical service quality receives a bounded per-step utility
changes_from_v1_3.continuous_relay_quality: relay quality is derived from its two physical link distances, while service completion remains binary and hold-time constrained

decision_rule: Run a full 1024-update baseline only if the terminal pilot validation contains non-zero bounded service value in at least two training seeds. Otherwise inspect the action interface before expanding budget.
interpretation_boundary: Development-only learnability calibration; not formal evidence and not a proposed-method result.
